subject: Pedestrian and Traffic Safety
overview: The Medford City Council met to vote on municipal appropriations, cemetery account transfers, and multiple resolutions concerning pedestrian safety, traffic enforcement, and speed limits across the city.

items.title: FEMA Reimbursement Appropriation for DPW Work
items.summary: The Council approved a $165,000 appropriation from FEMA blizzard reimbursement funds for DPW highway work, including tree stump removal, catch basin repairs, sidewalk repairs, tree planting, and street sign inventory.

items.title: Cemetery Department Budget Appropriations
items.summary: The Council approved transferring $158,800 from the Sale of Lots and Graves account to the cemetery salary account and $185,849 from Perpetual Care for groundskeeping expenses.

items.title: Building Code Violation Statistics Request
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting a report from the Building Department detailing code violation notices issued in the past year and corresponding criminal actions.

items.title: Speeding Ticket and Traffic Accident Statistics Request
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting monthly speeding ticket totals, local accident data, and citation locations from the Police Chief.

items.title: Pedestrian Advisory Committee Proposal
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution calling on the Mayor to establish a Medford Pedestrian Advisory Committee or expand the Complete Streets committee to include neighborhood resident representatives.

items.title: Speed Limit Reduction Request for High Street
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution petitioning MassDOT to lower the speed limit on High Street near the Brooks Elementary School to 25 mph and requesting increased State Police enforcement.

items.title: Crossing Guard and Traffic Measures near Brooks Elementary School
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting an additional crossing guard on High Street for middle school students and directing traffic reviews of nearby intersections.

items.title: Winthrop Street Rotary Traffic Safety Study
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting a city study to explore traffic safety and design options to improve the Winthrop Street Rotary.

items.title: Public Input on Police Staffing and Operations
items.summary: Resident Jeanne Martin addressed the Council regarding police department staffing levels, budget priorities, traffic enforcement, and equipment needs.

items.title: Route 16 Lighting Repairs and Meeting Schedule Adjustment
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution urging DCR to repair streetlights on Route 16, congratulated two local couples on anniversary milestones, and voted to cancel the November 8 meeting due to Election Day.

items.title: Special Permit for Keno Monitor at 562 High Street
items.summary: The Council removed a special permit application for a Keno monitor at NK Convenience from the table, heard from the applicant's attorney, and laid the matter back on the table pending legal review.

items.title: Approval of Prior Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved the minutes of the October 4, 2016 meeting.
